ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, there are two congruent triangles. The letters in the figure represent the lengths of the sides of the triangles. What is the degree measure of $\angle 1$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure,\\
by the triangle interior angle sum theorem, $ \angle 2=180^\circ-60^\circ-54^\circ=66^\circ$,\\
since the two triangles are congruent,\\
hence $ \angle 1=\angle 2=\boxed{66^\circ}$.
